lines.text: Some men fell into tar pits as the kings fled, and the four kings carried off Abram's nephew Lot.
Abram mobilized 318 trained men, pursued Chedorlaomer's army as far as Bethel, and brought back Lot and the goods.
Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, brought out milk and honey and blessed Abram.
Abram refused to take even a thread from the king of Sodom, but Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre could take portions.
